roles.title: MBA Intern - Commercialization Product Management
roles.notes: Only Databricks posting I found that combines MBA and Product Management in the title (requisition RDQ226R577 per aggregator). Marked CLOSED. Cycle year, location and pay not visible in search snippets. Source: https://weloveproduct.nuxt.dev/jobs/mba-intern-commercialization-product-management-databricks-ooq2qb (aggregator; WebFetch was blocked so I could not open the original). Borderline PM role: it sits on the Commercialization team.

notes: The generic 'Product Management Intern (Summer 2026)' and '(Summer 2027)' postings (12 weeks; San Francisco, Mountain View, Bellevue; $54-$56/hr SF Bay Area per Built In repost https://builtin.com/job/product-management-intern-summer-2026/6846997; 2027 postings show $51.50-$56/hr) want a BS/MS in CS or engineering graduating Fall 2027/Spring 2028, and the 2025 cohort was $48-$52/hr (Coatue board). They are NOT aimed at MBAs, so I left them out of roles. Levels.fyi shows a Databricks PM intern at $52/hr in SF for Summer 2025 (https://www.levels.fyi/internships/Databricks/Product-Manager-Intern), which likely refers to that technical track. Databricks' other MBA internships are adjacent functions and outside scope: MBA Intern - Product Operations ($40-$45/hr SF Bay Area; https://jobs.dcvc.com/companies/databricks/jobs/45139479-mba-intern-product-operations), MBA Intern - Product Pricing & Commercialization ($40/hr SF; Spring 2027 MBA grads; https://www.databricks.com/company/careers/business-strategy-and-ops/mba-intern---product-pricing--commercialization-8402615002), MBA Intern - Commercial Transformation ($40/hr). No timeline data found.

No MBA PM internship found on Scale's Greenhouse board or on aggregators. The closest MBA-facing role is 'AI Deployment Strategist Intern (Summer 2026)', New York, in-person, $86.54/hr per aggregator (https://simplify.jobs/p/26b73af1-2a9b-4a10-b6ae-7bb797dccf5a). It is a strategy/deployment role, not PM, so it is excluded. Scale's PM openings (e.g. Incubation PM, PM Gen AI) are full-time. Other interns are SWE, AI Builder and Technical Advisor.

roles.title: Product Manager Summer Intern
roles.notes: Aimed at MBA students with a strong technical background. The intern owns a scoped product initiative from discovery through execution and works with Product, Engineering, Research and GTM. Sources (aggregators): https://jobs.therundown.ai/jobs/191872835-product-manager-summer-intern and https://weloveproduct.nuxt.dev/jobs/product-manager-summer-intern-snorkel-lv97ov. Cycle year NOT confirmed (no date in snippets). Pay deliberately null: WeLoveProduct shows '$127,423 - $159,279*', but that is a site-wide estimate (asterisk = 'est.'). The identical figure appears on its Cloudflare listing, so it is not real posting data. I could not find the original Greenhouse posting (job-boards.greenhouse.io/snorkelai).

notes: Medium-low confidence that the role is current. Verify on Snorkel's Greenhouse board.

roles.title: AI Product Manager - MBA Intern (Summer 2027)
roles.notes: Official posting: https://c3.ai/job-description/8860563002 (I could not open it; fetch blocked). Pay comes from aggregators. Employbl shows $8,000-$10,000/month and Simplify shows $46.15-$57.69/hr, which is the same range converted at about 173 hrs/month, so the two agree. Confirm on the C3 page. Requires current MBA enrollment plus a bachelor's in CS, Engineering, Statistics or a similar analytical field, plus hands-on LLM/agent prototyping. Interview process: one anonymous Glassdoor review (Apr 2023, MBA intern) reports 3 interviews plus a ~10-hour take-home over 3 weeks, and poor recruiter follow-up (https://www.glassdoor.sg/Interview/C3-AI-Interview-E312703-RVW72994559.htm). Single dated data point.

notes: This is the only company in the group with a live Summer 2027 MBA PM posting I could identify (as of Oct 2026). C3 has run PM intern postings since at least 2022.

No PM internship (MBA or otherwise) found. Hebbia's public postings are full-time (Engagement Manager/Analyst, AE, Partnerships, Product Marketing). Extern's guide (July 2026, https://www.extern.com/post/hebbia-internship-guide) says the company has about 120 employees and no publicly listed intern program. Its predicted Oct-Nov 2026 window is a projection, not a confirmed date. Hebbia's Ashby/Greenhouse boards turned up no intern roles.

No current MBA PM internship found. SandboxAQ has run a general MBA internship program: the 2024 cycle was 3 months, full-time, fully remote in the US, with a June 2024 start and possible extension up to 12 months, focused on analysis/strategy (https://careercenter.bauer.uh.edu/companies/sandboxaq/jobs/). One undated listing says the MBA internship is offered exclusively in partnership with UVA Darden (https://jobs.weekday.works/sandboxaq-mba-internship). That suggests it may not be open to Wharton students. Not PM-specific. Its current PM roles are senior full-time (e.g. Staff Technical PM, $134k-$258k/yr).

roles.title: MBA Product Manager Intern - Summer 2026
roles.notes: Pay is from the Accel VC job board mirror of the posting. Another aggregator shows '$38-45 USD yearly', which is clearly a unit error. Onsite only. Three cohorts: Cohort 1 Wed May 20 - Fri Aug 7, 2026 (11.5 weeks) through Cohort 3 Mon Jun 15 - Fri Sep 4, 2026 (12 weeks). Requires current MBA with graduation Dec 2026-Jun 2027 and 3+ years of full-time experience. The intern writes a PRD for an assigned cybersecurity segment and presents to the VP of Product. Posting closed. No application, interview or offer dates found.

notes: The prior cycle was 'MBA Product Manager Intern - Summer 2025 (Remote)' (https://builtin.com/job/mba-product-manager-intern-summer-2025-remote/3670122). The program moved from remote to onsite for 2026. No Summer 2027 posting found as of Oct 2026. Pay is low relative to peers.

roles.title: Product Lead Internship - Summer 2026
roles.notes: Rippling calls PMs 'Product Leads', so this is the PM role. Requires MBA or master's students graduating 2027 with 2+ years of full-time experience. Hybrid, 3 days in office. Interns are placed in a product area during the interview process (team match). Pay is from a single aggregator, not verified on Rippling's page. $86.54/hr equals $180k/yr annualized. Posting copies: https://jobs.somacap.com/companies/rippling/jobs/54788362-product-lead-internship-summer-2026 (closed). Extern (https://www.extern.com/post/rippling-internship-guide) projects that Summer 2027 apps open Aug-Oct 2026, interviews run through Jan and offers through Feb, but it labels this a projection, so I left the timeline null.

notes: Rippling's blog says it doubled the 2026 intern program vs 2025 (https://www.rippling.com/blog/2026-internship-program). No Summer 2027 Product Lead posting found as of Oct 2026.

No PM or MBA internship found. PAR's product postings are full-time (Hardware PM, POS PM, Sr Technical PM) with 2-7+ years of experience, and an MBA is listed only as 'a plus'. The only intern listing found was a 2022 generic tech internship. Results for 'PAR Systems' are a different company.
